messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: SEV2 - Deployment rollback triggered for service=redwood-inference-runtime, reason=500s surge + crashloops in canary (alert: rollout-error-rate > 5%)

mary_oncall: Acked pager. I'm on it. Can someone confirm which deploy/version?

kevin_backend: Latest deploy 2026-03-17_09:12 (image: runtime:v2026.03.17-b2). Canary (5%) started showing CrashLoopBackOff after readiness fail. I have pod names: runtime-canary-7b9f, runtime-canary-7b9g

kevin_backend: quick logs from runtime-canary-7b9f: `2026-03-17T09:14:02Z ERROR server readiness probe failed: GET /healthz 403 permission denied`

sara_release: That matches the manifest change: readinessProbe path updated to /healthz and securityContext added in the container -> dropped network capability inadvertently. Rolling back probe change is my priority.

mary_oncall: Customer impact? Any 5xx spike in host metrics / frontends?

ops-bot: Telemetry: 2.1% global error rate increase last 10m, spike concentrated in eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Affected: ~3% of requests for API key tier=paid. No large latency regression.

pm-jordan: Escalating to CS: a small set of premium customers may see errors. I'll draft a message after we stabilize.

mary_oncall: Mitigation plan: 1) Toggle feature flag (sara) as kill-switch to stop canary traffic 2) If still failing, rollback to v2026.03.10 stable 3) If drain needed, coordinate node operations.

sara_release: Toggling feature flag now -> `ff-service toggle runtime-new-health-check false`

sara_release: :white_check_mark: Flag toggled. Confirming traffic reroute off canary.

ops-bot: Routing update: canary weight -> 0% in traffic-router. Confirmed by CDN router logs.

kevin_backend: Even with traffic off, pods are CrashLooping (some readiness failure still). Might affect node drain and eviction scheduling. Manifest has `terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 120` and a preStop hook that sleeps 90s. If we need to evict, pods take long to terminate.

mary_oncall: Any HPA involvement? Could autoscaler be thrashing?

kevin_backend: HPA on runtime scaled by CPU with minReplicas=3 and target=60%. During crashloops, we got a transient scale up to 10 which contributed to scheduling pressure. HPA config looks fine but combined with crashes it ramped up.

mary_oncall: Because canary traffic off, errors should stop. But we need to stop the crashloops causing node pressure. Options: 1) kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime --to-revision=2026.03.10 2) scale deployment down and reapply stable manifest 3) kubectl delete pod --grace-period=0 --force for stuck pods. Preference for controlled rollback.

kevin_backend: Initiating controlled rollback now: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/runtime --to-revision=3`

ops-bot: Controller: rollout undo started. Watching rollout status...

kevin_backend: Rolling back image to runtime:v2026.03.10-stable. Running `kubectl rollout status deployment/runtime -n prod`

kevin_backend: One pod stuck terminating on node ip-10-2-45-8; `kubectl describe pod` shows TerminationGracePeriod exceeded and preStop hook not completing due to container not responding to SIGTERM (OOM in previous run).

mary_oncall: If it won't terminate, force-delete to unblock node: `kubectl delete pod runtime-canary-7b9f --grace-period=0 --force -n prod` after confirming not customer-facing.

kevin_backend: Force-deleted stuck pod. New pod coming up with stable image. New pods show Ready.

ops-bot: Telemetry: error rate back down to baseline (0.3%) across regions. No more canary 5xx spikes.

pm-jordan: Customer comms: Notifying impacted customers with rollback summary and ETA for post-incident RCA.

mary_oncall: On-call handoff: I'm staying on until stable, then will document timeline and hand to next oncall in 2 hours. Please collect logs and PR refs for RCA.

kevin_backend: Note for RCA: problematic change in PR #1287 modified readiness path and securityContext, and preStop hook introduced. I'll attach diffs and pod logs to the incident ticket.

sara_release: Created rollback changelog entry and disabled the health-check change branch. Will open a hotfix PR: revert readiness path + add integration test for probe behavior.

ops-bot: Incident summary (auto): SEV2, root cause suspected bad readiness probe + preStop behavior in release v2026.03.17-b2 -> caused canary crashloops + HPA thrash. Mitigation: feature flag toggled, canary traffic removed, controlled rollback to v2026.03.10, force-delete of stuck pod. Impact: ~3% requests for paid tier in eu-west-1/us-west-2 saw 5xx for ~8m. No data loss.

mary_oncall: Thanks team. Next steps: RCA assigned to kevin + sara, postmortem draft by EOD tomorrow, add e2e probe test to CI before any readiness path changes. Handing off to night oncall in 2h if stable.

pm-jordan: Drafted customer note and posted to CS channel.

mary_oncall: Closing this thread once postmortem link and PRs are attached. :white_check_mark:
